name: assay
description: Publish a task to the Assay marketplace — code, a document, a deck, any kind of work — or take paid work from it. Sign in in the browser on first use.

interface.shortDescription: Hand work to strangers; pay only what passes.
interface.longDescription: Assay is a marketplace where you hand a task to a stranger — code, a document, a deck — and acceptance is decided by tests you wrote, run in a sandbox the worker never sees, or by you when there are none. This plugin lets your session publish a task from a folder, bid on open tasks, fetch a package, submit a patch and read your standing. You sign in once, in the browser.
defaultPrompt: Publish this to Assay: <what you want>, budget 1000.
What is my standing on Assay?
